verdict.rationale: Aleph documents its own drill-down in its Excel/Google Sheets reporting workflows. It also says agent answers carry clickable, cited sources you can trace back to the source of truth, so some number-to-source traceability is a first-party capability. But nothing shows that any report number can be traced step by step through the formulas and calculations down to the underlying source transaction lines. Missing for 10: documented formula/calculation lineage for report figures, explicit drill-to-source-line detail for reports and dashboards (not just agent answers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, any number in a report traces back through the formulas and source lines that produced it
